text:
```yaml
name: Spellcheck PR

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  spellcheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Install spellcheck tool
        run: cargo install codespell

      - name: Run spellcheck
        run: codespell --check-filenames --check-words --skip="./target,./.git,./Cargo.lock"
```
